events.continuity_hook: Continues the Santa Fe personal-weekend episode after the initial comparison of Albuquerque versus Santa Fe airport options.
events.interaction_goal: Narrow the weekend plan to a flight approach and hotel choice, with the trade-offs centered on reliability, drive timing, walkability, parking, and cancellation terms.
events.scenario_brief: Jonah revisits the Santa Fe long-weekend plan after his spouse says she would rather avoid a tight connection into the smaller airport. The Albuquerque nonstop plus rental-car drive is now favored, but he wants to check whether the later Friday arrival still leaves a relaxed drive and dinner window. The hotel choice is down to a historic Plaza-area inn with a higher prepaid rate versus a newer Railyard-area hotel with easier cancellation and parking; walkability and adjacent seating matter more than work-trip room basics.

events.continuity_hook: Completes the Santa Fe planning thread once the flight approach and cancellable hotel are accepted.
events.interaction_goal: Finalize the personal-weekend flight, hotel, rental-car, and seating details in a concise confirmation summary.
events.scenario_brief: Jonah is ready to book the Santa Fe weekend after confirming they can both leave the Bay Area after lunch Friday. The selected plan is a Friday afternoon nonstop into Albuquerque, a Monday return that does not require an early departure from Santa Fe, and the more flexible Railyard-area hotel with strong guest feedback and restaurant access nearby. The remaining details are rental-car pickup timing, hotel parking cost, and assigning two seats together rather than prioritizing a window.

events.continuity_hook: Starts a new work-trip episode after the Santa Fe personal weekend is booked.
events.interaction_goal: Build a flight-and-hotel shortlist that protects the Tuesday morning site-access window while keeping the return flexible until the debrief timing is confirmed.
events.scenario_brief: A municipal utility visit outside Kansas City is added to Jonah's calendar. He needs to be at an Olathe-area wastewater facility early Tuesday for safety processing, then run a distributor lunch-and-learn on Wednesday; a short client debrief may push the return from Wednesday evening to Thursday morning. He wants to compare Bay Area departures to MCI, including a convenient United connection versus a cleaner nonstop or one-stop option on another carrier, and he needs a hotel around Olathe or Overland Park with reliable guest ratings, parking, practical in-room basics, and nearby dinner options.

events.continuity_hook: Continues the Kansas City-area site-visit episode after the Monday arrival cushion becomes more important than the original after-lunch departure preference.
events.interaction_goal: Choose the safer outbound routing, settle the hotel location trade-off, and check rental-car and late-arrival logistics before booking.
events.scenario_brief: The utility's security office confirms badge pickup must happen before close of business Monday, and the distributor asks Jonah to inspect a shipped demo case that evening. That makes the later Bay Area departure too tight, so he needs to compare an earlier SFO routing against an Oakland departure with a cleaner arrival at MCI. The hotel decision has also narrowed to an Olathe property close to the plant versus an Overland Park option with better dining nearby; the unresolved question is whether the extra drive is acceptable for the early Tuesday start.

events.continuity_hook: Completes the Kansas City-area work-trip episode after the debrief uncertainty drops away and the safer outbound plan is approved.
events.interaction_goal: Finalize the flight and hotel booking, capture seat and room requests, and prepare arrival details for the utility security office and distributor contact.
events.scenario_brief: Jonah gets approval for the Kansas City-area trip and the client confirms no Thursday meeting is needed. The selected plan is a Monday early-afternoon departure that arrives at MCI with time for badge pickup and demo inspection, a Wednesday evening return after the distributor session, and a well-rated Overland Park hotel that keeps the plant drive manageable while offering better evening dining. He wants the room notes to request a coffee maker and mini-fridge, and he wants a window seat if the carrier allows seat selection.

events.continuity_hook: Starts a new conference-planning episode after the Kansas City utility visit is booked.
events.interaction_goal: Create a practical conference shortlist covering flight timing, official-block versus nearby hotel options, cancellation terms, and the unresolved teardown responsibility.
events.scenario_brief: Registration opens for a regional water-reuse conference in Denver, with booth setup expected Sunday afternoon and sessions Monday through Wednesday. The official hotel block is convenient but filling quickly, while several nearby hotels have better guest ratings or more flexible cancellation terms. Jonah needs to compare Sunday afternoon Bay Area flights against a Saturday arrival if a customer dinner is added, and the Wednesday return depends on whether a colleague can handle the last part of booth teardown.
